representation: Reports, prompts and receipts are byte-exact. Complete delivered sources are in losslessly gzipped chains. Raw execution payloads remain local; audit summaries are explicit bounded derivatives.
independence: Independent initials share the frozen source packet. Original-reviewer confirmations retain their identity. A replacement is explicitly attributed to a fresh same-family reviewer re-reading reconstructed source evidence, not retained original context. Context-held conclusions are excluded from the replacement inputs and from acceptance, but preserved under held-runs.
limits: Bounded textual and host evidence, not native/device or arbitrary-pool acceptance.
